newsitem.title: UK: European jet jumps with gas oil, arb nearly open.
newsitem.headline: European jet jumps with gas oil, arb nearly open.

text.p: European jet prices jumped around $7.00 with gas oil and prompt supply was limited with the arbitrage from the Caribbean still just closed, dealers said.
A UK refiner bid Oct +$36.00 cif for 10,000 tonnes, but was uncountered by an offer. A Russian kerosene cargo was talked around benchmark cif quotes -$6.00 cif ARA.

A broker said the arbitrage from the Caribbean was about $3.00 per tonne out of the money. Gulf and Libyan cargoes were not coming into Europe because of the 6 percent duty on this product, he added. Spot premiums to benchmark prices in the Mediterranean were around $9/$10 per tonne. -- Tom Ashby, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8145
